TERAFAB: Records show that SpaceX, through affiliate company WIT TECH LLC, has purchased six parcels of land totaling +2,700 acres in Grimes County. The areas include:

- 348.59 legal acres on FM244 in Iola, Texas, directly on the east side of the Gibbons Creek Reservoir near Millennium Power. Appraised value of $2.15 million.

- 1.249 legal acres on Rose Road in Iola, Texas, directly on the Navasota River with a low dam. Appraised value of $33,440.

- 3.83 legal acres on Rose Road in Iola, Texas, includes river pump stations. Appraised value of $116,050.

- 1694.17 legal acres on Timbercreek Trail in Iola, Texas, west of the Gibbons Creek Reservoir. Appraised value of $781,800.

- 414.88 legal acres on Timbercreek Trail in Iola, Texas, west of the Gibbons Creek Reservoir. Appraised value of $99,500.

- 433.79 legal acres. Location unknown. Appraised value of $32,260

Everyone obsesses over Starship's height and thrust.

The number that actually matters: cost per kg to orbit.

Falcon 9 brought it from ~$54,500 (Shuttle era) to ~$1,500. Starship targets <$100.

A 500x reduction in 25 years. That's the curve enabling Mars, lunar bases and orbital industry. Everything else is a consequence of that one number.
